name: unbound
description: Reads the Unbound resolver: its query report, the sole source of site names (data source 5), the records it holds in its cache, the records it serves from its local data, and, when the firewall sends them over syslog, its query and reply log lines.

endpoints.name: search_queries
endpoints.note: Read-only. JSON body with integer timeStart/timeEnd is the correct form and is confirmed; the window is nevertheless ignored, so what comes back is never coverage of the window asked for.

endpoints.name: dump_cache
endpoints.survey_section: Resolver cache and local data, read from source for the resolver-cache cycle
endpoints.note: {status, data: [{host, ttl, type, rrtype, value}]}; ttl is the remaining seconds as a string, or null on a message-cache reference line, which is not a record; type is the class. configd: https://github.com/opnsense/core/blob/26.7.3/src/opnsense/service/conf/actions.d/actions_unbound.conf [dumpcache]; script: https://github.com/opnsense/core/blob/26.7.3/src/opnsense/scripts/unbound/wrapper.py; ACL: https://github.com/opnsense/core/blob/26.7.3/src/opnsense/mvc/app/models/OPNsense/Unbound/ACL/ACL.xml

endpoints.name: list_local_data
endpoints.survey_section: Resolver cache and local data, read from source for the resolver-cache cycle
endpoints.note: {status, data: [{name, ttl, type, rrtype, value}]}; ttl is the configured TTL, type is the class. configd: https://github.com/opnsense/core/blob/26.7.3/src/opnsense/service/conf/actions.d/actions_unbound.conf [listlocaldata]; script: https://github.com/opnsense/core/blob/26.7.3/src/opnsense/scripts/unbound/wrapper.py; ACL: https://github.com/opnsense/core/blob/26.7.3/src/opnsense/mvc/app/models/OPNsense/Unbound/ACL/ACL.xml

push.name: query_log
push.survey_section: Push sources: remote syslog and NetFlow export, read from source for push sources
